zh-CN.title: 聊天细节更准确
items: 群聊连续消息会正确展示每位发送者的头像
移动端可从菜单标题旁快速切换空间账号

en.title: More accurate chat details
items: Consecutive group messages now show the correct sender avatar
Switch space accounts quickly beside the mobile Menu title
Travel map messages now use one consistent bubble surface
